message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now strips accent marks from the title before passing it to slugify.

I didn't touch `vendor/slugify/index.js`, because its header says not to edit it by hand. Shop product URLs use the same vendored function (`src/shop/product-url.js`), so they still drop accented letters. If you want them fixed too, the better place is an upgrade of the vendored package, or the same normalization in that wrapper.
